import java.util.*;
import java.math.BigInteger;

public class Main {
    static class Modular {
        long val;
        static final long MOD = 1000000007;

        public Modular() {
            this.val = 0;
        }

        public <U> Modular(U v) {
            long value = ((Number) v).longValue() % MOD;
            if (value < 0) value += MOD;
            this.val = value;
        }

        public static Modular operatorAdd(Modular a, Modular b) {
            Modular res = new Modular();
            res.val = a.val + b.val;
            if (res.val >= MOD) res.val -= MOD;
            return res;
        }

        public static Modular operatorSubtract(Modular a, Modular b) {
            Modular res = new Modular();
            res.val = a.val - b.val;
            if (res.val < 0) res.val += MOD;
            return res;
        }

        public static Modular operatorMultiply(Modular a, Modular b) {
            Modular res = new Modular();
            res.val = (a.val * b.val) % MOD;
            return res;
        }

        public Modular pow(long p) {
            Modular result = new Modular(1);
            Modular base = this;
            while (p > 0) {
                if ((p & 1) == 1) result = operatorMultiply(result, base);
                base = operatorMultiply(base, base);
                p >>= 1;
            }
            return result;
        }

        public Modular inv() {
            // Fermat's little theorem for modular inverse
            return this.pow(MOD - 2);
        }

        public static Modular operatorDivide(Modular a, Modular b) {
            return operatorMultiply(a, b.inv());
        }

        @Override
        public String toString() {
            return Long.toString(val);
        }
    }

    public static void main(String[] args) {
        Scanner sc = new Scanner(System.in);
        int number = sc.nextInt();
        Modular[] probability = new Modular[number * number];
        for (int i = 0; i < probability.length; i++) {
            int percentage = sc.nextInt();
            probability[i] = new Modular(1).operatorMultiply(new Modular(percentage)).operatorDivide(new Modular(100));
        }

        List<Modular> total = new ArrayList<>();
        int middle = number / 2;

        int[] maskValue = new int[1 << 6];
        int count = 0;
        for (int matchMask = 0; matchMask < maskValue.length; matchMask++) {
            if (Integer.bitCount(matchMask) == middle) {
                maskValue[matchMask] = count++;
            } else {
                maskValue[matchMask] = -1;
            }
        }
        total = new ArrayList<>(Collections.nCopies(1 << count, new Modular()));

        int[] maskVal = new int[1 << 6];
        for (int i = 0; i < maskVal.length; i++) {
            maskVal[i] = Integer.bitCount(i) == middle ? maskValue[i] : -1;
        }

        // process function
        class Processor {
            void process(int left, int right, BiConsumer<Integer, Modular> handle) {
                int len = right - left;
                int totalEdges = 1 << (len * number);
                for (int edgeMask = 0; edgeMask < totalEdges; edgeMask++) {
                    Modular totalProbability = new Modular(1);
                    int tmp = edgeMask;
                    boolean skip = false;
                    for (int i = left * number; i < right * number; i++) {
                        if ((tmp & 1) != 0) {
                            totalProbability = Modular.operatorMultiply(totalProbability, probability[i]);
                        } else {
                            totalProbability = Modular.operatorMultiply(totalProbability, new Modular(1).operatorSubtract(new Modular(1), probability[i]));
                        }
                        if (totalProbability.val == 0) {
                            skip = true;
                            break;
                        }
                        tmp >>= 1;
                    }
                    if (skip) continue;

                    int[] data = new int[3];
                    Arrays.fill(data, 0);
                    int matchSets = 0;
                    outer:
                    while (true) {
                        int matchMask = 0;
                        for (int index = 0; index < len; index++) {
                            if (((edgeMask >> (index * number + data[index])) & 1) == 0) {
                                continue outer;
                            }
                            if ((matchMask & (1 << data[index])) != 0) {
                                continue outer;
                            }
                            matchMask |= 1 << data[index];
                        }
                        if (right == number) {
                            matchMask ^= (1 << number) - 1;
                        }
                        matchSets |= 1 << maskVal[matchMask];

                        // increase data
                        int i = len - 1;
                        while (i >= 0) {
                            if (data[i] == number - 1) {
                                data[i] = 0;
                                i--;
                            } else {
                                data[i]++;
                                break;
                            }
                        }
                        if (i < 0) break;
                    }
                    handle.accept(matchSets, totalProbability);
                }
            }
        }

        Processor processor = new Processor();

        // process first half
        for (int i = 0; i < total.size(); i++) {
            total.set(i, new Modular(0));
        }

        final List<Modular> totalRef = total;
        processor.process(0, middle, (sets, probabilityVal) -> {
            totalRef.set(sets, Modular.operatorAdd(totalRef.get(sets), probabilityVal));
        });

        // subset sum
        for (int dim = 1; dim < total.size(); dim <<= 1) {
            for (int i = 0; i < total.size(); i++) {
                if ((i & dim) == 0) {
                    total.set(i | dim, Modular.operatorAdd(total.get(i | dim), total.get(i)));
                }
            }
        }

        Modular result = new Modular(0);
        final List<Modular> totalFinal = total;
        processor.process(middle, number, (sets, probabilityVal) -> {
            result = Modular.operatorAdd(result, Modular.operatorMultiply(probabilityVal, Modular.operatorSubtract(totalFinal.get(totalFinal.size() - 1), totalFinal.get(totalFinal.size() - 1 - sets))));
        });

        System.out.println(Long.toString(result.val));
        sc.close();
    }
}
